sentences.en: Impoverished, uneducated adolescents living in rural areas are most affected.
sentences.zh: 农村地区生活着的贫困、缺乏教育的青少年受影响最大。

sentences.en: Haiti is a nation that seems hopelessly impoverished.
sentences.zh: 海地似乎是一个 hopeless 地陷入贫困的国家。

sentences.en: The war lasting for years impoverished the country.
sentences.zh: 多年的战争使这个国家变得贫穷。

senses.zh: 使(某人)贫穷 使(某物)贫瘠或恶化
